title: 10 percent coupon gives wrong checkout total
proposal: CheckoutService.quote divides subtotalCents * couponPercent by 1000, applying one tenth of the intended percentage discount. Change only BigDecimal.valueOf(1000) to BigDecimal.valueOf(100) in CheckoutService.java, preserving HALF_UP cent rounding and validation. For 10000 cents and 10 percent, discount becomes 1000 and total becomes 9000 cents.
